title: A General Approach to Enharmonicism
summary: We propose a general approach to enharmonicism within syntactic music theory; that is, we formalize several abstract structures of enharmonicism without any acoustic considerations. The structures of concern to this paper are constructed from diatonics, chromatics, and enharmonics, and we seek to present a general enharmonic theory that builds upon Hook's enharmonic theory published in "Enharmonic Systems: A Theory of Key Signatures, Enharmonic Equivalence and Diatonicism" (2007).
